name: Your Glove Source
old_description: First time customers get $5.00 off your first order over $35.00, using Discount code FTC.
about:
Your Glove Source operates from Tijeras, New Mexico. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business functions as a distributor and online retailer of hand protection products, offering a broad selection of disposable and reusable gloves sourced from established brands such as MaxiFlex, Gloveworks, Samurai, Ice Gripster, and G‑Tek. Its catalog spans nitrile, latex, vinyl, and cut‑resistant Dyneema gloves, sold in quantities ranging from single boxes to 1,000‑glove cases. The site also features a clearance section for discounted, discontinued, or damaged goods.

Customers come from medical and dental offices, food‑service and restaurant operations, automotive and general manufacturing shops, tattoo studios, and construction crews. The product lineup includes exam‑grade nitrile and latex gloves, food‑service vinyl gloves, heavy‑duty nitrile work gloves, and ANSI‑rated cut‑resistant models for industrial use.

The company promotes competitive pricing, free shipping on select case orders, and a first‑order discount for new buyers.

name: Zenergy Solar & Roofing
old_description: Zenergy Solar has helped homeowners across Delaware, Southern New Jersey, and Eastern Pennsylvania go solar since 2005. With roughly two decades in business, thousands of satisfied customers, and BBB accreditation, we design and install residential solar and home battery systems that lower electric bills and add lasting value to your home.
about:
Zenergy Solar & Roofing operates from Wilmington, Delaware, where it was founded in 2005 as a small company focused on helping homeowners reduce energy costs. The business has grown over roughly two decades into a full-service home upgrade contractor serving the Mid-Atlantic region.

The company designs and installs residential solar arrays, battery storage systems, EV chargers, roofing, HVAC and heat-pump equipment, insulation, and smart-home controls. Each project begins with a free home energy audit that uses thermal imaging, blower-door testing, drone roof scans, and water testing to produce a custom scope of work. In-house crews carry out all installations, and the firm coordinates permitting, inspections, and utility interconnection.

Zenergy serves homeowners throughout Delaware (Wilmington, Newark, Dover), southern New Jersey (Cherry Hill, Marlton, Mount Laurel, Willingboro, Brick), and eastern Pennsylvania (Philadelphia suburbs and the PECO territory). Its customer base is exclusively residential, and the company highlights thousands of completed projects across the three-state area.

Leadership says the business was started out of an obsession with saving homeowners money and a commitment to finishing every job to a single standard. The firm emphasizes one coordinated team, premium materials such as GAF shingles and tier-1 solar panels from Tesla, Generac, Q CELLS, and Silfab, on-time completion, and 24/7 system monitoring backed by workmanship and product warranties.

name: Zongkers Custom Woods Inc
old_description: Established in 1989, Zongkers has excelled as an industry leader with premium, handcrafted fine furniture and cabinetry.
about:
Zongkers Custom Woods Inc was founded in 1989 by brothers Dennis and Dan Zongker in Omaha, Nebraska. The family-owned business began as a dedication to preserving the artistry of furniture making, operating from the historic Metz Brewery building near 3rd and Hickory streets.

The company manufactures premium, handcrafted fine furniture and cabinetry, producing each piece individually with an artist's signature to guarantee authenticity. Its capabilities span custom design, engineering drawings, finish sampling, and detailing, with specialties in hand-carving, marquetry veneer inlays, curved furniture, and specialty finishes. The shop serves both commercial and residential projects, fabricating conference tables, reception desks, workstations, dining sets, kitchen cabinetry, entertainment centers, bedroom suites, and liturgical furnishings.

Zongkers serves corporate clients outfitting offices and lobbies, residential customers seeking heirloom-quality pieces, and religious institutions requiring custom liturgical items. The firm's portfolio includes complete commercial interiors, premium kitchens, and specialty carvings such as life-size statues and prayer kneelers.

The brothers built the business on the principle of original, one-at-a-time fabrication, distinguishing themselves from volume-oriented shops by involving clients from concept through finish selection and delivering signed, one-of-a-kind works backed by over 35 years of craftsmanship.

name: Zwirner Equipment Company
old_description: Quality Equipment for Food, Beverage, and Industrial Applications
about:
Zwirner Equipment Company was founded in 1996 in Hartsville, Tennessee, roughly 45 minutes northeast of Nashville International Airport. The business began as a supplier of used stainless steel tanks and processing equipment and has since expanded into a multi-service operation.

The company buys, sells, and trades new and refurbished stainless steel tanks, pumps, valves, fittings, and related processing equipment. Its inventory includes vessels such as a 40,000-gallon single-shell vertical storage tank and a 10,000-gallon refrigerated horizontal cylindrical tank, as well as reconditioned Fristam pumps. Zwirner also acts as a distributor for WEG washdown motors and drives. In-house capabilities cover reconditioning and remanufacturing to original specifications, custom stainless steel fabrication, onsite maintenance and emergency repair, nationwide equipment transportation and installation, equipment appraisal, and auction representation.

Customers span the dairy, food processing, beverage and brewing, chemical, and pharmaceutical industries. The company emphasizes sanitary-grade stainless steel equipment for manufacturers requiring hygienic processing standards.

Zwirner cites its three decades of industry experience and broad service portfolio as key differentiators, noting that its team’s skill enables faster turnaround times and reduced downtime for clients.

name: ePac Flexible Packaging
old_description: Finding the right flexible packaging manufacturer for your brand can make all the difference. ePac is pleased to offer high-quality, custom printed flexible
about:
ePac Flexible Packaging operates its Los Angeles-area manufacturing facility in Chino, California, which opened in 2019. The site is part of ePac Holdings, LLC, a network of locally equipped flexible packaging plants. The Chino location serves brands throughout Southern California with full-service production capabilities.

The company produces custom printed flexible packaging, including stand-up pouches, lay-flat pouches, and rollstock, using an HP Indigo 20000 digital printing press. Its services cover pre-press, print-to-demand production, and multi-SKU order management for short and medium runs. High-barrier premium pouches and child-resistant packaging options are available, with ingredient lists and warning labels printed directly on the package.

ePac Los Angeles serves food, beverage, and natural-product brands of all sizes. Customers include regional companies such as safe + fair, gezellig, kettle head, two brothers, cassava, energy boost, Slice of Sauce, and Sunrise Organics and Naturals Corp. The facility also partners with Naturally Bay Area and Naturally San Diego, organizations supporting sustainable food entrepreneurship.

The company emphasizes quick time-to-market, shipping orders in 5–15 business days with no plate fees and low minimum quantities. Its print-to-demand model aims to eliminate excess inventory, and all products are manufactured in the USA. Community ties include workforce development with HP and Fullerton College and support for the Let It Be Foundation.

name: ​e-Components, a Division of CSR Electronics, Inc.
old_description: We are a highly motivated and experienced technical sales team​ with existing relationships. This affords us the ability to engage at the executive and architectural level of tiered customers. ​Our relationships, line card, technical abilities, and ADRP allow us to engage at the earliest architectural stage of product development.
about:
e-Components, a division of CSR Electronics, Inc., operates from Raleigh, North Carolina. The firm was established in 1980 as a manufacturer's representative organization serving the southeastern United States. No founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The company functions as a technical sales and representation firm, maintaining a limited, focused line card of electronic component suppliers. Its account managers embed directly with customer engineering teams to engage at the architectural design stage through a proprietary Architectural Design Resource Process (ADRP) and Resource Selling Model. The territory spans Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, Mississippi, North Carolina, Puerto Rico, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, and the District of Columbia. The firm cites over 200 years of combined employee experience across sourcing, product development support, agency validation, and coordination of onshore and offshore manufacturing.

Customers include tiered OEMs in electronics markets, with Bosch Automotive noted as a reference account. The firm targets vertical and emerging markets, emphasizing early engagement in product development cycles. Its supplier relationships are described as long-term, with a focus on manufacturers.

e-Components differentiates itself through embedded account management, the ADRP methodology, supplier advocacy, and membership in the Electronic Representatives Association (ERA). The company stresses operational excellence, financial stability, and a flexible, urgent response culture.

name: 185 Promotions & Apparel
old_description: Swag. Promos. Branded giveaways. Whatever you call it, we make it unforgettable!
about:
Based in Carmel, Indiana, with a second office in Bloomington, 185 Promotions & Apparel is a woman-owned promotional products company that has been serving clients for over two decades. The business was founded as a woman-owned enterprise (WBE) and has built its reputation on promotional expertise.

The company sources and customizes a wide range of promotional merchandise, including apparel, bags, writing instruments, tech products, and drinkware. Its services encompass custom company stores, school spirit-wear websites, branded kits, and unique merchandise programs. In-house capabilities include custom t-shirt design and embroidery, allowing clients to add logos and artwork to stock items.

185 Promotions & Apparel works with corporate clients needing branded merchandise for employee stores and with educational institutions seeking spirit wear for students and alumni. The firm also assembles custom kits for events, onboarding, and marketing campaigns, serving organizations that require turnkey promotional solutions.

The company emphasizes a customer-focused approach, highlighting its team’s problem-solving mindset and commitment to innovative solutions with exceptional service. Its woman-owned status and deep promotional experience are presented as key differentiators in a crowded marketplace.
